integrity.description: The agent used the Zotero GUI rather than manipulating the database via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking menus and typing in the Zotero application window; no terminal windows showing sqlite3 or python scripts are used to modify the Zotero database.

integrity.description: The agent created a dynamic 'Saved Search' rather than a static 'Collection'.
integrity.visual_evidence: The icon in the sidebar for 'Papers Since 2010' is a purple folder with a magnifying glass (Saved Search), not a regular yellow folder (Collection).

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename an existing folder.
integrity.visual_evidence: The screenshots show the process of defining the search logic (Date/Year criteria) within the search dialog.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The library contains 18 papers total. 10 are 'Classic' (1905-1960) and 8 are 'ML' papers (2012-2020). A correct search for 'Papers Since 2010' must use the 'Date' or 'Year' field and should return exactly 8 papers: AlexNet (2012), GANs (2014), Deep Learning (2015), ResNet (2016), AlphaGo (2016), Transformer (2017), BERT (2019), and GPT-3 (2020). The name must be exactly 'Papers Since 2010'.
